authority: CEO Round 155: 'Every competitor capability must carry DEMONSTRATED/DISCLOSED/INFERRED/UNKNOWN. Never say cannot unless evidence supports it. Build competitor-baseline experiments. Add COMPETITIVE_BASELINE_SUPERIORITY to World-Class gate.'

competitor_capability_epistemology.rule: Every competitor capability statement must carry an epistemic status. Never convert UNKNOWN into CANNOT_DO.

statuses.DEMONSTRATED: Publicly demonstrated in published work, clinical trial, or product documentation. Source + date required.
statuses.DISCLOSED_IN_DEVELOPMENT: Publicly stated as in development (press release, pipeline disclosure, regulatory filing). Source + date required.
statuses.INFERRED: Inferred from public capability + general engineering knowledge. Not directly demonstrated. Confidence + rationale required.
statuses.UNKNOWN: No public evidence found. Cannot be converted to CANNOT_DO. Correct language: 'NO_PUBLIC_EVIDENCE_OF_CAPABILITY'.

VIEshunt_cannot_predict_failure.old: VIEshunt CANNOT do latent degradation detection
VIEshunt_cannot_predict_failure.corrected: NO_PUBLIC_EVIDENCE that VIEshunt performs latent degradation prediction. VIEshunt's published work demonstrates control and acute response (DEMONSTRATED). Future work section mentions need for 'statistically relevant conclusions' (DISCLOSED). No prediction capability is described (UNKNOWN).
VIEshunt_cannot_predict_failure.epistemic_status: UNKNOWN (no public evidence of prediction capability)

ThecaFlex_is_open_loop.corrected: ThecaFlex DRx is DESCRIBED as an implantable intrathecal port/catheter platform (DEMONSTRATED — hardware). The published description supports open-loop delivery characterization (DEMONSTRATED). Whether Biogen is developing closed-loop intelligence internally is UNKNOWN (no public disclosure).

Nature_ICP_monitor_cannot_predict.old: Nature ICP monitor monitors pressure but doesn't interpret
Nature_ICP_monitor_cannot_predict.corrected: Nature 2026 ICP monitor DEMONSTRATED wireless long-term pressure monitoring in 20 patients (DEMONSTRATED). The published study mentions detection of some shunt failures (DEMONSTRATED — basic failure detection). No published evidence of prediction or failure-mode classification (UNKNOWN).
Nature_ICP_monitor_cannot_predict.epistemic_status: DEMONSTRATED (pressure monitoring + basic failure detection) + UNKNOWN (prediction/classification)

competitor_baseline_experiment_specs.rule: Every successor hypothesis must have a BEST_PUBLIC_COMPETITOR_BASELINE vs PROPOSED_INVENTION comparison with pre-registered technical metrics. Mandatory before World-Class promotion.

C2_Y_vs_VIEshunt.baseline: VIEshunt-like adaptive control system (posture detection → reference adjustment → ICP regulation + acute perturbation response)
C2_Y_vs_VIEshunt.proposed: C2-Y: Longitudinal Response-Manifold Failure Prediction (perturbation → compare to baseline → predict failure)
C2_Y_vs_VIEshunt.key_question: Does C2-Y provide measurable lead-time advantage over VIEshunt-like adaptive control for detecting latent degradation?

pre_registered_thresholds.win: C2-Y lead time >24h AND false alarms <1/patient-month AND failure-mode accuracy >70%
pre_registered_thresholds.kill: C2-Y lead time <4h OR false alarms >3/patient-month
pre_registered_thresholds.intermediate: between win and kill — C2-Y remains INCONCLUSIVE

C2_Y_vs_VIEshunt.experiment: Virtual cohort with gradual degradation (healthy → 95% → 90% → ... → clinical failure). At each stage: (A) static pressure threshold, (B) VIEshunt-like control deviation, (C) C2-Y response-manifold deviation. Measure lead time, false alarms, classification.

C3_X_vs_ThecaFlex.baseline: ThecaFlex-like open-loop intrathecal delivery (clinician programs dose → device delivers, no feedback)
C3_X_vs_ThecaFlex.proposed: C3-X: Closed-loop CNS delivery (CSF state → PK model → adaptive dosing → response monitoring)
C3_X_vs_ThecaFlex.key_question: Does C3-X provide measurable therapeutic advantage over ThecaFlex-like open-loop delivery?

metrics.primary: drug_concentration_stability (CV of CSF drug concentration over time)

pre_registered_thresholds.win: C3-X concentration CV <50% of open-loop AND overdosing events reduced >60%
pre_registered_thresholds.kill: C3-X concentration CV >80% of open-loop OR no significant overdosing reduction

C3_X_vs_ThecaFlex.experiment: Virtual cohort with patient-specific CSF pharmacokinetics. Compare open-loop (fixed dose) vs closed-loop (adaptive dose based on CSF state estimation). Measure concentration stability, over/under-dosing, optimization benefit.
C3_X_vs_ThecaFlex.buyer_value: Biogen paid $85M for ThecaFlex. If C3-X demonstrates closed-loop advantage, Biogen's acquisition thesis strengthens: ThecaFlex becomes a therapy system, not just a port.

C5_X_vs_best_public_thrombus_prediction.baseline: Best publicly demonstrated thrombus fragmentation prediction approach (from 2026 computational review PMID 42508673 + digital twin review PMID 41663082)
C5_X_vs_best_public_thrombus_prediction.proposed: C5-X: Predictive Embolic-Risk Engine (validated precursor + patient-specific twin + intervention optimization)
C5_X_vs_best_public_thrombus_prediction.key_question: Does C5-X provide materially better embolic-risk prediction than best public computational approach?

pre_registered_thresholds.win: C5-X AUROC >0.85 AND survives independent solver (actual clotFoam) AND provides actionable intervention recommendation
pre_registered_thresholds.kill: C5-X AUROC <0.70 OR does not survive actual clotFoam

C5_X_vs_best_public_thrombus_prediction.experiment: Multi-world simulation (FEBio + Peridigm + clotFoam + virtual cohort). Compare C5-X prediction vs best-public-method on same virtual cohort.
C5_X_vs_best_public_thrombus_prediction.dependency: Requires actual clotFoam execution (OpenFOAM build in progress)

conditions: 8. COMPETITIVE_BASELINE_SUPERIORITY (NEW — must demonstrate material advantage over strongest publicly demonstrated alternative)
updated_world_class_gate_v3.new_condition_rationale: A candidate cannot become World-Class merely because it works. It must demonstrate a material advantage over the strongest publicly demonstrated alternative. The machine asks: 'Why does the world need this invention if the best existing system already does almost the same thing?'
updated_world_class_gate_v3.all_eight_required: No compensation between dimensions. Scientific strength cannot compensate for weak competitive moat. Commercial attractiveness cannot compensate for weak science.
